'''Makeb Drilling Platforms''' were the mining platforms used by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in the [[Cartel mining mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. The platforms used mining lasers to drill into the planet's core for [[isotope-5]]. During the conflict, [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces attacked the platforms and commandeered them in order to halt the planet's impending destruction.<ref name="TOR" />

==List of Makeb Drilling Platforms==
The Hutt Cartel attached six mining platforms to the mining mesa on Makeb. Four of them were known by their names. They were:
*[[Drilling Platform Duba]]
*[[Drilling Platform Fwanna]]
*[[Drilling Platform K'wanna]]
*[[Drilling Platform Keeta]]

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mining_Mesa.jpg|thumb|250px|Concept art of Makeb Drilling Platforms]]
Makeb Drilling Platforms were added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' along with the rest of the planet Makeb in the [[2013]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> Their model for the game was designed by [[Clint Young]], an art director and concept artist, who worked as a senior conceptual artist of Star Wars: The Old Republic at Bioware.<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=clintyoung|url=artwork/NEPoz|name=[[Clint Young|Clinton Young]]|text=Star Wars: Laser Drilling Platform}}</ref>
